svg.title: Invitation lifecycle and independent mail state
svg.desc: Issuing an Invitation creates one pending immutable purpose package and a durable mail intent. From pending, acceptance atomically applies the package, replacement creates a new Invitation and supersedes the old one, revocation invalidates it, or PostgreSQL time expires it. Resend keeps the package but rotates the secret and deadline. Mail delivery is separate: pending does not mean delivered, and sent mail is harmless after terminal Invitation state.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Segoe UI, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The package is durable; the link is disposable

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Segoe UI, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Every terminal transition reads current Invitation state. Mail delivery never overrides it.
